column3: “An adversary” is rendered as the name “Satan.” “Incited” is rendered “moved,” and “count” as “number.”
“Like them a hundred times” is rendered “a hundred times as many as they are,” and “subjects” as “servants.”
“Went about in all Israel” is rendered “went throughout all Israel.”
“Enrolled” is rendered “number,” and “the word of the king” as “the king's command.”
“It was displeasing in the eyes of God” is rendered “God was displeased.”
“Cause to pass away” is rendered “take away,” and “guilt” as “iniquity.”
“To overtaking” is rendered “overtakes you,” and “consider what word I will bring back” as “consider what answer I shall return.”
“It is distress to me exceedingly” is rendered “I am in great distress,” and “compassions” as “mercies.”
“Just as he was destroying” is rendered “as he was about to destroy it,” “relented” as “was sorry,” and “let drop your hand” as “relax your hand.”
“Did I not say to count” is rendered “Is it not I who commanded to count”; NASB adds “Indeed.” “Not to a plague” is rendered “that they should be plagued.”
“Said to Gad” is rendered “commanded Gad,” and “set up” as “build.”
“The place” is rendered “the site,” and “for full money” as “for the full price”; NASB supplies “you shall.”
“Indeed certainly I will acquire” is rendered “No, but I will surely buy,” and “for nothing” as “which costs me nothing.”
“Spoke to” is rendered “commanded,” and “returned” as “put back.”
